bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
printf 'STK04_USERBOT_IPC_CLIENT_HELP\n'
python3 scripts/userbot_test_client.py --help 2>&1 | head -n 110 || true
printf 'STK04_RESIDENT_ACTION_NAMES\n'
grep -nE 'ALLOWED|ACTION|action|read_message|messages|pinned|list_topics|get_message|topic|verify' scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py 2>/dev/null | head -n 85 || true
printf 'STK04_USERBOT_SERVICE_FLAGS\n'
systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service || true
systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service || true
echo STK04_USERBOT_INSPECTION_DONE
